notes.title: Version 7.0 RPYT: Fixes for many issues + improvements to the beginning.
notes.content:
-- I finally changed the glow around Resop for high quality settings.

-- Added levels and sound effects at the start of the game.

-- Added new code.

-- Fixed the reflection bug on Resop that caused duplication.
The animation was duplicated and made the rendering strange,
for example, Resop’s leg appeared multiple times with a delayed double animation.
This improves performance for those playing on medium and high quality.

-- Some dialogues were rewritten to be easier to understand.

-- Changed the rewards given at the start depending on the player's level.

-- When the game crashed and triggered a screamer, it now restarts correctly and closes CMD windows.
Improved the monitor.bat file.

-- Fixed an issue during the hide-and-seek section where the audio saying "You can Skype lvl" was cut off.
It now plays properly if you’re struggling.

-- Fixed small bugs and problematic details.

-- Minor changes at the beginning.

-- Alerts and information if FPS is too low.

And even more! Because there were also, uh… some mini updates between V6 and V7!

[previewyoutube=tw1L7tBaGuk;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: 🈴✨🌍 Translate any game! Patch? 🌍✨🈴
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=eu1hCuwKYtk;full][/previewyoutube]

"I’m going to show a solution to easily translate my game into any language!
(Works on any game.) 🌍

My game is currently only available in French and English.
I don’t plan to make a patch in another language unless, one day, my game becomes very popular and the community absolutely wants a patch in their language. (My game is created on old software, certain characters like Japanese are not recognized, so it’s impossible to officially translate my game into Japanese.)

But with a great software called ScreenTranslator,
you can easily and quickly translate anything on the screen! 😎

There are great videos showing you how to easily install the software.
I recommend my settings for better ease of use.

❗🛑Important things to use the software correctly.🛑❗

-- The translation can be poor if the software struggles to understand the text.
For example, it works well if the text is on a black background and well highlighted.

-- Avoid capturing too much of the scenery and make sure the text is emphasized.

-- Use my settings for the best experience (Of course, with your own language).

-- The software tries to translate names, which could, for example, translate "Paz" as "papa"... Which is incorrect.

-- If the software struggles to translate, break the text into smaller pieces.

Also, if you need help, feel free to join the Discord for my game.

With that, the language barrier no longer exists! 💪
(Of course, this software isn’t mine, I’m just sharing it to help the many players of my game who don’t speak French or English. I’ve seen many Japanese players enjoy my game, but be disappointed that they can’t play in their language. Here’s an alternative for all of you!)

(Download link in the video description. There’s also another tutorial by someone else in the description if you’re having trouble.)"

notes.title: Version 6.0 RPYT: ( Civil and listens to players, update.)
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=0JEp5gXH-P4;full][/previewyoutube]

-- In the city, the survivors' zone is finally available!
You can meet survivors there who will give you side missions or information!

-- The beginning has been redone to be more interactive and with less boring dialogue!
More gameplay! A certain character will even note your player skills!

-- Taking into account different feedback and players who have played my game to significantly improve the beginning!
Fewer deaths at the start, more coordinates when you don't go where you need to, more indications, etc. Arrows highlighted, etc...

-- Change of the menu in its resolution and fluidity.
More alerts if you incorrectly rotate the game and your device is not powerful enough...

-- There are also new images and new choices!

-- New characters!

-- More moments where it rings automatically at the entrance door!

-- In the water, now we lose health little by little.

-- Fix of a serious glitch!
When leaving the futuristic shop, if you speed downwards, it could block your save.
When leaving the futuristic shop now, it's much cleaner!

-- And another bug in multiplayer that could break the save due to the points room.

-- + more code.

-- Menu change if no save is present.

-- And plenty of other things fixed or added in a major update that listens to players!

notes.title: ⛄✨🎄 Version 5.0 RPYT: ( Christmas Update ! And More !) 🎄✨⛄
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=qW-0iSlkm-I;full][/previewyoutube]

-- Addition of Christmas special content!
Every year, from November 16th to December 26th,
Resop Paz switches to Christmas mode!
The decoration changes!
It snows!
And there are gifts that can contain many different things inside!
There are also more features related to dates and times!

On Christmas Day, there is something special in the shop!




-- Chandelier fix in the manor.
If the chandelier reaches a certain speed, it can corrupt the game!
I adjusted it to make it more realistic, beautiful, and smooth!


-- More code!


-- Modification of certain dialogues.



-- Added voices and small messages to notify players.
For example, when the controller is really incompatible!
Or to indicate where the main mission is located.
I noticed many players getting lost at the start of the game and not continuing the main story despite the arrows...
So, there will be more moments where Resop will talk to help you.
For the egg at the beginning, I added more time and a sound to make it clear.




-- Changed image and text of the intro.



-- Changes to the points room: decor, difficulty, location, etc.




-- Chaloutre now appears the first time with more health: 25 instead of 15.
This helps the player understand that, to send Chaloutre on a mission, he needs to be in good health.




-- Added a new level in the points room: it’s sports!





-- At any time, while controlling our character,
someone can knock at the manor’s front door.
Different people may show up.
We will have the choice to open the door or not.

(Suspicious packages, rude kids, or characters we've previously met—there will be several choices!)




-- Fixed an issue with special music.
When progressing through the manor, the music is supposed to continue between levels.
It should not restart, as it increased crash risks due to memory usage.




-- Improved animation when Resop wakes up from a fainting spell.




-- ... There is a possibility to see the king of the universe without the mask...




-- Changed the loading screen.



And much more! New characters and other surprises await! It's up to you to discover them!

notes.title: Version 4.0 RPYT: ( Multiplayer local And More)
notes.content:
-- Performance improvements. For example, in the scientist mission, there were slowdowns on maximum quality.
Also, for those who play on the lowest quality, I removed certain background levels if the lowest quality is selected.

-- Small graphic improvement.

-- Bug fixes and details.

-- Multiplayer improvement.
You can finally select the multiplayer mode!
You can still do the story mode with 3 players.
But this multiplayer mode is based on teamwork or player vs player combat!
You can also now revive each other. J2 and J3 can revive each other with the quick hit button. J1 can also revive them.

-- More code!

-- Mine patch. The mine was too overpowered and won too much!

-- Small change on Résop Paz 1 Retro, which will be replaced.

-- New music!

-- New boss available (Nebula Tous).
In multiplayer mode. (The multiplayer mode can be played solo even though it is made for more players).

-- Changes to some of the game's cinematic videos.

-- Added choices.

-- Added new dialogues and modified some of them, including one that was poorly corrected and translated, which could make me seem like a lunatic XD.

-- Changed the game's credits.

-- Check if you have an old save. If yes, you will write a message and launch the old version. Because yes, saves cannot really be played on the wrong versions.

- Modification of certain videos.
